Enhancements: [Jira-68158] TMS 2.0 - Add deposit status and support refund with third party payment - Dev
Descriptions:
This task is to add TMS deposit processing status under third party payment (especially after Completed), and to support refund / transfer in deposit workflow with segregation of duties.
New / updated deposit related status and amount under third party payment:
Awaiting Refund / Awaiting Transfer (waiting for approval before refund or transfer)
Refunded (existing)
Transferred
Consumed by POS, consumed amount = $xxx
Payment List is also changed to an independent page for search and follow-up actions.
Setup:
HQ – Admin Navbar
Moved payment relate into “Payment Setup”.
HQ – Schedule Third Party Payment Status Update
Modified function, it only allow set in config-zone now.
HQ - Config by Location
Go to Admin Page -> “Table Management System” (TMS) -> Other Settings -> Config by Location
Select section Payment. Two new configs are added:
Awaiting Refund in Deposit Workflow — Require awaiting refund status before entering refund in deposit workflow
Awaiting Transfer in Deposit Workflow — Require awaiting transfer status before transfer deposit
The Config by Location – Payment section is as below.
Add New: Apply To All Locations / Outlet / Shop. Value No / Yes (empty = No, y = Yes).
When Value = Yes, user without refund / transfer authority cannot refund or transfer immediately. After confirmation the payment is changed to Awaiting Refund / Awaiting Transfer and needs approval.
When Value = No, user without authority is blocked and will not enter awaiting status.
HQ - Function Authorities
Go to Admin Page -> “Table Management System” (TMS) -> Authority Control -> Set Function Authorities
Refund / transfer authority is set by function “Refund Payment” and “Transfer Payment”.
Value empty (allow): user can refund / transfer directly.
Value No (n): no authority. If SoD config = Yes, payment goes to Awaiting Refund / Awaiting Transfer. If SoD config = No, action is blocked.
Value Ask Authority (ask_*): system will popup Ask Authority first.
Offline payment: user without authority is blocked. Will not enter Awaiting Refund / Awaiting Transfer.
Add New for Awaiting Refund in Deposit Workflow is as below.
After save, the listing (All Locations = Yes) is as below.
Awaiting Transfer in Deposit Workflow uses the same Add New / listing. After save is as below.
HQ - Payment Transfer Reasons
Go to Admin Page -> “Table Management System” (TMS) -> Payment Setup -> Payment Transfer Reasons
This setup is used when transfer deposit to another reservation.
Payment Transfer Reasons listing is as below.
Add New Payment Transfer Reason is as below.
Operation – Cancel Reservation and Void Payment
Add dialog for void payment when cancel reservation as below.
To turn on this function, we need to modify setting in outlet setting as below.
TMS Operation - Payment List
In TMS Operation, Payment List is an independent page (header credit card icon), not inside reservation list dialog.
Filters: Outlet, Create Payment Date, Payment Method, Third Party Payment Status.
Third Party Payment Status: Pending, Completed, Cancel, Expired, Refunded, Awaiting Refund, Awaiting Transfer, Refund Requested.
Columns include Confirmation No., names, Transaction ID, Transaction Trace ID, Payment Create Date, Payment Method, Amounts, Third Party Payment Status, Action, Payment Link.
Amounts show Total / Refunded / Consumed / Remain. Consumed amount is from POS consume. Remain = Total – Refunded – Consumed.
Consumed amount is mainly for payment status Completed. Void / Refund and Transfer are not allowed when the payment is consumed or already transferred.
Create Payment Date default is today. Date range maximum is 1 month. Use date picker shortcuts Past 7 Days / Past 1 Month to search.
Payment List (independent page) is as below.
Payment List with records and amount details is as below.
Click a row to open payment details side panel.
Payment details side panel is as below.
Awaiting Refund
If user has no refund authority and Awaiting Refund in Deposit Workflow = Yes, Void / Refund will not call third party. After confirmation the payment status is changed to Awaiting Refund.
If Refund Payment is Ask Authority (ask_*), Void / Refund will popup Ask Authority first. If operator cancel Ask Authority and Awaiting Refund in Deposit Workflow = Yes, payment will be changed to Awaiting Refund (no third party call).
Ask Authority dialog is as below.
Applicant can View Request / Cancel Request. Approver (has refund authority) can View Request and Accept / Reject. Reject will not call third party.
Awaiting Refund confirmation (no refund authority) is as below.
Payment List after request (status Awaiting Refund) is as below.
View Request (approver) is as below.
Transfer
Awaiting Transfer uses the same SoD logic as Awaiting Refund, with Awaiting Transfer in Deposit Workflow and transfer payment authority. Payment Transfer Reason is selected when transfer.
When transfer, operator must select Payment Transfer Reason and search the target reservation (Confirmation No. / date / last name / first name), then select the target booking.
PayBy / webhook callback
When PayBy or other third-party gateway finishes a payment or refund, TMS updates the payment status automatically.
If Payment List is already open, the matching row (status and amounts) is updated by itself. Staff do not need to refresh the page.
Status may show Pending or Refund Requested first, then change to Completed / Refunded when the gateway result arrives. Still no need to refresh.
POS Payment API
Description
TMS defaults the deposit is consumed when the reservation status changes to completed. This API is only used for requesting refunded/ awaiting refund/ consumed/ last_consume
Update the payment record by payment Id, the return result included the full set of: -
Payment Basic Information
Payment Method Information
Third Party Payment Gateway Record (TmsPaymentGatewayRecord)
Request for example
| JSON Sample File |
| {    "interface": "gm",    "module": "tms",    "fcn": "updateDepositsByReservationId",    "body": {       "resv_id": "9c3f2a10-6b7d-4e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b",       "deposits":           [             {                "rpay_id": "9c3f2a10-6b7d-4e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e312345",                "consumption": {                   "consumed_total”: “0.0000”                },                “refund”: {                    “refund_total”: "250.0000"                }             }          ],               "module_alias": "pos",       "user_id": "1"    } } |
Request
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| interface | gm |  | Y |  |
| module | tms |  | Y | Module name |
| fcn | updateDepositsByReservationId |  | Y | Get payments by reservation Id |
| Param Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| resv_id | 2306503d-9e21-478c-a94e-c8eb0595f34a | String | Y | Reservation (TmsResv) Id |
| deposits | [{}] | Array Object | Y | Array Object of deposits – Update Deposits by Reservation Id |
| module_alias | pos | String | Y | Module alias to mark which module try to update the deposit information. Expect value: pos |
| user_id | 1 | String | Y | The user who performs this action |
Array Object of deposits – Update Deposits by Reservation Id
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| rpay_id | 5a9c2d18-6f4b-4d6e-8c2a-1b9f0c3d7a12 | string | Y | Tms Reservation Payment (TmsResvPayments) ID |
| consumption | {} | Object | N | Object of consumption – Update Deposits by Reservation Id |
| refund | {} | Object | N | Object of refund – Update Deposits by Reservation Id |
Object of consumption – Update Deposits by Reservation Id
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| consumed_total | 0.0000 | String | Y | The consumed total in POS uses a decimal format of (15,4)  Not larger than rpay_pay_total, pass 0.0000 means not consumed |
Object of refund – Update Deposits by Reservation Id
| Variable Name | Value | Data Type | Mandatory | Description |
| refund_total | 250.0000 | String | Y | Refund total of the payment uses a decimal format of (15,4)  Not less than original refund and not larger than rpay_pay_total |
